name: importexport
description: AWS Import/Export Service AWS Import/Export accelerates transferring large amounts of data between the AWS cloud and portable storage devices that you mail to us.

subcommands.name: cancel-job
subcommands.description: This operation cancels a specified job.

subcommands.name: create-job
subcommands.description: This operation initiates the process of scheduling an upload or download of your data.

subcommands.name: get-shipping-label
subcommands.description: This operation generates a pre-paid UPS shipping label that you will use to ship your device to AWS for processing.

subcommands.name: get-status
subcommands.description: This operation returns information about a job, including where the job is in the processing pipeline, the status of the results, and the signature value associated with the job.

subcommands.name: list-jobs
subcommands.description: This operation returns the jobs associated with the requester.

subcommands.name: update-job
subcommands.description: You use this operation to change the parameters specified in the original manifest file by supplying a new manifest file.
